nation: Every nation has its own flag and its own song.
Wales is a small nation with green hills.
The people of one nation may speak a different language from ours.
donation: Mum made a donation of old books to the charity shop.
Was your donation to the cat shelter a blanket or a toy?
What a kind donation of books for our school library!
creation: He was proud of his creation, a tall tower made of cardboard.
The baker's new creation was a cake shaped like a boat.
Is this robot your own creation?
exploration: Mum took the map and led our exploration along the beach.
What an exciting exploration, going up every hill to look around!
Astronauts go on a long exploration to learn about the moon.
invitation: Mum helped me write an invitation for my party.
Thank you for the invitation to tea at your house!
Please reply to the invitation by next Friday.
decoration: We hung a shiny decoration on the Christmas tree.
Which colour balloons make the best decoration for a party?
The cake had one tiny sugar decoration on top.
education: Going to school is part of your education.
Teachers work hard to give every child a good education.
What a good education we get from our kind teachers!
information: Ask the helper at the desk for more information.
I looked in a book to find information about frogs.
Can you give me some information about the school trip?
celebration: Our street held a celebration with cake and games.
Diwali is a happy celebration with lights and sweets.
Is the birthday celebration at the park on Saturday?
imagination: Use your imagination to picture a castle in the clouds.
With a lot of imagination, a blanket can become a tent.
Does your imagination ever take you to the moon?
